+def _routes(data):
+    required = data.get("required", [])
+    bits = {node: 0 for node in range(data["n"])}
+    for i, node in enumerate(required):
+        bits[node] |= 1 << i
+    full = (1 << len(required)) - 1
+    graph = [[] for _ in range(data["n"])]
+    for edge in data["edges"]:
+        graph[edge["u"]].append(edge)
+    start_state = (data["source"], bits[data["source"]], data["coupons"])
+    start_time = data["start"]
+    distances = {start_state: start_time}
+    queue = [(start_time, *start_state)]
+    while queue:
+        time, node, mask, coupons = heapq.heappop(queue)
+        state = (node, mask, coupons)
+        if distances.get(state) != time:
+            continue
+        if node == data["target"] and mask == full:
+            return {"arrival": time}
+        for edge in graph[node]:
+            depart = max(time, edge["open"])
+            if depart >= edge["close"]:
+                continue
+            choices = [(edge["duration"], coupons)]
+            if coupons:
+                choices.append((max(2, edge["duration"] - edge.get("discount", 0)), coupons - 1))
+            for duration, remaining in choices:
+                arrival = depart + duration
+                if arrival > data["deadline"]:
+                    continue
+                next_state = (edge["v"], mask | bits[edge["v"]], remaining)
+                if arrival < distances.get(next_state, float("inf")):
+                    distances[next_state] = arrival
+                    heapq.heappush(queue, (arrival, *next_state))
+    return {"arrival": None}
